definitions.gloss: area around the mouth, lips and mouth area
definitions.explanation: The region of the face around and including the mouth. Often referenced when describing facial expressions, makeup, or physical features.

examples.japanese: {口元|くちもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{笑|え}み→笑み：13768_emi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浮|う}かべた→浮かべる：13314_ukaberu⟧。
examples.english: A smile appeared around the mouth.

examples.japanese: ⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{口元|くちもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{隠|かく}れている→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧。
examples.english: The area around the mouth is hidden by a mask.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口元|くちもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{押|お}さえ→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: She laughed quietly while covering her mouth with her hand.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口元|くちもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{笑|え}み→笑み：13768_emi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浮|う}かべる→浮かべる：13314_ukaberu⟧ (have a smile on one's lips)
- {口元|くちもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧ (cover one's mouth area)
- {口元|くちもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}さえる→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧ (hold one's hand over one's mouth)
- {口元|くちもと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{緩|ゆる}む→緩む：10056_yurumu⟧ (the corners of the mouth relax into a smile)

Frequently used in literary and descriptive writing to convey subtle facial expressions. The similar term {口許|くちもと} uses a different kanji but has the same meaning.
